notes.title: Patch 1.0.2: Achievement fix
notes.content: Achievements now fully work within the game!

notes.title: Update: "Spacewar" and Playtime error
notes.content:
[b]"Spacewar" and Playtime error[/b]
We are aware of an error that is going on where a game called "Spacewar" appears in the users library and there is no game time being added to The Quran

"Spacewar" is a steam testing game and we have forgotten to remove the file from the folder that runs this game instead of The Quran, which is "steam_api64.dll" and we apologize for the inconvenience.
